newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladeshi port put on storm alert.
newsitem.headline: Bangladeshi port put on storm alert.

text.p: Bangladesh's main Chittagong port was on alert on Tuesday after a warning a monsoon storm brewing in the Bay of Bengal might hit the coast, port officials said.
"The persisting low in the northwest Bay of Bengal today has turned into a well-marked low forming a monsoon depression," an official with the meteorology department said.
The department urged Chittagong port, which handles nearly 80 percent of the country's cargo, to be prepared and warned ships of rough seas.
A severe storm in May killed over 100 people and made thousands of families homeless.
